class: a base worktree without the gitignored files its suites read, so the base failed for its environment and the same failures at the candidate read as carried
caught_by: base.copy lists repo-relative paths that a worktree base copies from the checkout, following links, after the worktree is added and before prepare. A missing source, or a path tracked at base or in the working index, makes the base not-run (vacuous), and tracked is read by any spelling: a letter-case variant, a path the fresh worktree already holds or reaches through a link or file there, or a checkout link to a tracked file. A copy that cannot be made is vacuous too, never an engine error; the base line lists what was copied, and every record names the declared inputs it saw
missed_by: a worktree holding tracked files only: the suites that read an ignored environment file failed at base by assertion, so a real regression in them would have been carried

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
